en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet riverside village with a timber‑framed house in the foreground, a bare tree and telephone pole beside a canal or small river, and a covered wooden bridge over the water in the mid‑distance. A child leans on a wooden railing near the water. In the background on a gentle hill stands a church with a tall baroque-style tower and spire, surrounded by clustered village buildings and fields.
